calls.title: Dave DAngelo and Ashley Stirrup
calls.summary: The team discussed enhancing their lead generation approach by targeting companies with over 1 million monthly visitors, which has already shown an increase in win rates and lead quality. Geoffrey Lugli reported engaging several high-profile prospects, aligning with Ashley Stirrup's strategy to filter out lower traffic firms. They plan to integrate outreach lists from relevant events and utilize internal tools like Apollo and Clay for effective contact sequencing. A new weekly report on content publishing schedules was agreed upon to improve LinkedIn engagement, emphasizing timely posting and interaction. The team outlined plans to target industry-related conferences to attract guests while focusing on local brands in Utah that have sufficient e-commerce traffic. Open communication and timely feedback were highlighted as key for successful lead generation.
calls.keywords: A/B Testing, Lead Generation, Podcast Promotion, ICP Broadening, Conference Outreach, Web Traffic Filtering
calls.action_items:

Send Ashley the current list of six warm leads for review and feedback (14:04)

Adjust outreach orientation toward industries Ashley identifies as priorities, including travel, gaming, and e-commerce (19:00)
Avoid pursuing prospects using internal homegrown experimentation tools where possible (15:28)

Discuss with Tanner and Jeff to deliver a publishing schedule and report to Ashley by end of day (10:50)
